description: Look up a phone model's probable eSIM compatibility by model name (for example 'iPhone 12 mini' or 'Galaxy S21'), using a device list and optional supplier check. Returns supported=true/false/null, close model matches and caveats; null means unknown, not incompatible. Always advise users to confirm an EID and carrier unlock status, especially for regional variants; this is not a purchase approval.

model.description: Full commercial phone model such as iPhone 13 or Galaxy S23; include region variant when known.
